en.hubeali: heasws said: ‘And it was so after that, Yaqoubas used to get hisas caller to call out during every morning, from his house, upon a Farsakh (about four miles), ‘Indeed! The one who wants the lunch, so let him come to Yaqoubas!’. And when it was evening, he called out, ‘Indeed! The one who wants the dinner, so let him come to Yaqoubas!’’.
en.sarwar: 5. From the previous chain:In another Hadith

it is said that Jacob thereafter would announce around his home up to a distance of three miles every morning, “Whoever needs food, come to the house of Jacob” and in the evening also would announce, ‘Whoever needs dinner come to the house of Jacob.’”
